cues: The radius to x one, y one has slope y one over x one, so the tangent has slope minus x one over y one.
Simplify, using the fact that the point is on the circle, and the tangent is x x one plus y y one equals a squared.
For a general circle, replace x squared by x x one, y squared by y y one, two x by x plus x one, and two y by y plus y one.
And the normal always passes through the centre.
